claims.text: Give a statin @ the maximally tolerated dose as early as poss after ACS, regardless of lipid levels, unless contraindicated (eg, statin-induced myopathy, liver dysfun).
claims.quote: Thus, all patients without contraindications (eg, statin-induced myopathy, liver dysfunction) to therapy should receive a statin at the maximally tolerated dose as early as possible following ACS regardless of their serum lipid levels (1, 4).
claims.locator: Other Medications for Post-acute Treatment of Acute Coronary Syndrome

claims.text: Cont indefinitely unless sig SE occur.
claims.quote: The statin should be continued indefinitely, unless significant adverse effects occur, and dose should be increased to the maximally tolerated dose.

claims.text: Add ezetimibe, a PCSK9i, or bempedoic acid if LDL stays ≥ 55 to 70 mg/dL (per the pt's target) after 4 to 8 wks on the maximally tolerated statin, or if ⍉statin = tolerated.
claims.quote: A non-statin lipid-lowering medication (such as ezetimibe, a PSCK9 inhibitor, or bempedoic acid) should be added for patients whose low-density lipoprotein (LDL) level remains ≥ 55 to 70 mg/dL (≥ 1.81 mmol/L), depending on the individual's target level, after 4 to 8 weeks on maximally tolerated statin therapy, or for those who are not able to tolerate a statin at all.

claims.text: MSD: routine LFT monitoring isn't necessary, and routine CK doesn't predict rhabdomyolysis; check musc enzymes only if myalgias or other musc Sx develop.
claims.quote: Routine monitoring of liver enzyme levels is not necessary, and routine measurement of creatine kinase (CK) is not useful to predict the onset of rhabdomyolysis. Muscle enzyme levels need not be checked regularly unless patients develop myalgias or other muscle symptoms.

claims.text: If Sx don't subside w.in 1 to 2 wks off the statin, look for another cause (eg, polymyalgia rheumatica).
claims.quote: If symptoms do not subside within 1 to 2 weeks of stopping the statin, another cause should be sought for the muscle symptoms (eg, polymyalgia rheumatica).

claims.text: Atorvastatin: use w cyclosporine or gemfibrozil = ⍉recommended;
claims.quote: Concomitant use of cyclosporine or gemfibrozil with LIPITOR is not recommended.
claims.locator: 7.1 Drug Interactions that may Increase the Risk of Myopathy and Rhabdomyolysis with LIPITOR

claims.quote: Avoid intake of large quantities of grapefruit juice, more than 1.2 liters daily, when taking LIPITOR.
claims.locator: 7.1 Drug Interactions that may Increase the Risk of Myopathy and Rhabdomyolysis with LIPITOR

claims.text: Atorvastatin: tell pts to promptly report unexplained musc pain, tenderness or weakness, esp w malaise or fever.
claims.quote: Instruct patients to promptly report any unexplained muscle pain, tenderness or weakness, particularly if accompanied by malaise or fever.

claims.text: Atorvastatin: d/c when preg = recognized, or weigh the pt's ongoing need;
claims.quote: Discontinue LIPITOR when pregnancy is recognized. Alternatively, consider the ongoing therapeutic needs of the individual patient.
Lactation: Breastfeeding not recommended during treatment with LIPITOR ( 8.2 ).
